caller_has_validator_role.meaning: the caller of batchTransfers/rBatchTransfers holds the validator role

source_is_kyc_verified.meaning: the address holding the funds to be moved is marked isKycVerified

destination_is_kyc_verified.meaning: the destination address is marked isKycVerified (false means non-KYC or sanctioned)

funds_moved_to_non_kyc_destination.meaning: a validator batch call debits KYC-verified addresses and credits a non-isKycVerified destination in one call

assumptions: The batch transfer path is the checked action; standard transfer/transferFrom/mint/burn KYC gating is the reference behavior the batch path is claimed to bypass.
The report describes the bypass as a capability of the privileged validator key rather than an observed on-chain transaction.

unresolved.description: Report does not establish whether batchTransfers, rBatchTransfers, or either alone suffices for the bypass; the plan treats the batch path generically.
No concrete amounts, token quantities, or specific addresses are given for the moved funds; the effect is bound as an occurrence observable.

limitations: Pause-bypass (i_pause_blocks_movement / v_pause_bypass) is a separate impact handled in another claim-generation pass and is not formalized here.
Onward routing and regulatory-risk impacts are downstream consequences not covered by this plan.
The KYC-gate relation is bound at the occurrence level because the report supplies no numeric amounts or address constants.
